About
Bleach: Next is an MMORPG game based on the very popular serialized and completed anime: Bleach. With realtime combat mechanics, head out and destroy the opposing threat, become stronger and prove your strength against players and bosses. Choose between races from the bleach universe. Become a Shinigami to slay wicked Hollows, become a Hollow to face off against the Shinigami, or maybe you wish to cleanse the world with the powers as Quincy. The choise is yours.
Features
  • Realtime Combat: Experience responsive, real-time battles where your actions and timing matter. Fight enemies using skills and movement in the moment.

  • Pixel movement: Move freely with pixel-perfect precision. Navigate the world in any direction for smooth, responsive control and fluid exploration.

  • Intelligent monsters: Bosses react dynamically in combat, using tactics to outmanouver players.

  • Expansive dungeons: Explore interconnected dungeons filled with secrets and hidden paths. Each area offers a new and harder challenge, with higher rewards.

  • Rewards: Though the game is purely focused on the toolkit you choose, based on race, rewards grants you statboosts, speed and/or achievements.
